{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
segment_by_channel = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Customer segment distribution by channel:')
print(segment_by_channel)

# Compute average revenue per segment, by channel
avg_revenue_by_segment = df_clean.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nAverage revenue per completed order by channel and segment:')
print(avg_revenue_by_segment)

# Compute overall average revenue by channel (already done above)
overall_avg = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean().round(2)
print('\nOverall average revenue by channel:')
print(overall_avg)"}
